title: Civic Notice: Mandatory Gratitude
description: A scheduled hour of mandatory civic gratitude. Please feel thankful. Do not approach the reservoir.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: This is a test of the Snazzie F M Civic Notification System. <p:0.5> Residents of all districts are reminded that the scheduled hour of gratitude begins now. Please feel thankful.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: If you are unable to feel thankful, remain seated and continue smiling until the feeling arrives. <p:0.3> It will arrive.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: Do not approach the reservoir. <p:0.3> The sound under the reservoir is grateful enough for everyone.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: This concludes the scheduled hour of gratitude.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-deep
lines.text: <p:0.5> Thank you for your gratitude. It has been noted, as always. <p:0.3> Please remain calm. You have always been calm.
